svg.title: Rideshare Rails API architecture diagram
svg.desc: Structural diagram showing the Rideshare Rails 7 API app connected to a single PostgreSQL 18 database, with internal Rails layers, core DB tables, and a DB users panel listing the postgres, owner, app, and app_readonly roles.
